decisions.recommendedModelRationale: Five-factor IaaS recommendation: (1) Legacy ComputerEase with 4-hr vendor SLA needs continuous monitoring, not one-time build. (2) MuleSoft IDP rule-library tuning is operational work. (3) Peerless has no in-house MuleSoft dev — Brian Cook is platform-IT, not integration owner. (4) Akoya PE-sponsor + Roger Greenhagel 'first 18 months' window = managed-service relationship positions DataSkate for next Akoya platform play. (5) Elevate Fence Partners national rollout = UC1–UC4 is the template for 5 sibling brands; template needs ongoing maintenance as state-specific rules accumulate.
edgeCases: 4 flows sits at top of 1–5 retainer band. Promotion of UC5+UC6 would jump retainer to 6–10 band.
At 4 flows, IaaS Year 1 ≈ Implementation Only flat fee — IaaS only wins on Year 2+. Implementation Only only if Peerless hires a MuleSoft developer before kickoff (not signaled).
Anypoint $50K license bundle ($0 implementation) not in play — no Anypoint license sale discussed.
